articles.title: Animals crossing: the simple solution to stop roadkill in the Amazon
articles.summary:
Installation of eight canopy bridges in Alta Floresta has enabled 15,000 safe crossings by animals including spider monkeys and marmosets – and more bridges are planned elsewhere

By about 7am, with dense fog blanketing the landscape, Gabriel Falquetto had already come across several road-killed animals along the ES-164 highway in Brazil’s Espírito Santo state. The biologist was on his way to Kaetés private natural heritage reserve (RPPN) in the Atlantic Forest, where he monitors wildlife and roadkill.

Then he spotted the lifeless body of a primate on the pavement. It was a buffy-headed marmoset (Callithrix flaviceps), a species listed as critically endangered on the International Union for Conservation of Nature red list. An estimated 2,500 individuals remain in the wild, making it one of the world’s most threatened primates.

articles.title: Latin America's online betting rulebook is being rewritten, and compliance is now the price of entry
articles.summary: Brazil's regulated betting and gaming sector paid R$8.75 billion in federal taxes between January and July 2026, almost 77% more than in the same period of 2025. archive.security_status_en: South America is experiencing heightened political friction as Brazil's presidential race heads to a runoff after a razor-thin first round pitting right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro closely against incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Concurrently, U.S. federal prosecutors have escalated pressure on Venezuela by bringing new torture and repression charges against deposed leader Nicolás Maduro. The region also continues to grapple with localized security threats from organized crime, illegal mining networks, and extreme weather events in Chile and Colombia.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se pozornost trhů zaměří na předvolební kampaň před druhým kolem v Brazílii a vývoj kolem nových obvinění vůči venezuelskému vedení. Sledovat se budou také makroekonomická data z Argentiny.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, market focus will center on the campaigning ahead of Brazil's presidential runoff and reactions to the intensified U.S. legal pressure on Venezuela. Argentine macroeconomic releases will also be closely monitored.

archive.security_status_cs: Region čelí politické polarizaci před druhým kolem prezidentských voleb v Brazílii, kde pravicový kandidát Flávio Bolsonaro posiluje pozici, a rostoucímu tlaku USA na Venezuelu v čele s novými obviněními proti Nicolásu Madurovi. Chile se navíc potýká s extrémními záplavami a sesuvy půdy po historicky nejdeštivějším říjnu.
archive.security_status_en: The region is facing high political polarization ahead of Brazil's presidential runoff, where right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro is strengthening his stance, alongside mounting U.S. legal pressure against Venezuela's Nicolás Maduro. Meanwhile, Chile is dealing with severe flooding and mudslides following its wettest October on record.
archive.forecast_cs: V příštích dnech se očekává vyostření kampaně před brazilským druhým kolem voleb a sledování dopadů silných dešťů v Chile na infrastrukturu.
archive.forecast_en: The coming days will likely see intensified campaigning ahead of the Brazilian presidential runoff and ongoing assessment of infrastructure impacts from Chile's heavy rains.
